description: This file declares utility functions and constants related to JSON messaging over sockets, types conversions, and includes necessary headers for a project involving socket communication within the 'cuttlefish' namespace.

methods.name: SendJsonMsg
methods.description: Sends a JSON value over the specified client socket. Returns true if the entire JSON object was successfully sent.

methods.name: RecvJsonMsg
methods.description: Receives a JSON value over the specified client socket. Returns an optional JSON value, which contains the JSON object if the operation was successful.

methods.name: StrToReqTy
methods.description: Converts a string to a RequestType enum value.

methods.name: ReqTyToStr
methods.description: Converts a RequestType enum value to its string representation.

methods.name: StrToIfaceTy
methods.description: Converts a string to an IfaceType enum value.

methods.name: IfaceTyToStr
methods.description: Converts an IfaceType enum value to its string representation.

methods.name: StrToStatus
methods.description: Converts a string to a RequestStatus enum value.

methods.name: StatusToStr
methods.description: Converts a RequestStatus enum value to its string representation.
